title: How to File for Divorce in California (2027): Fees & Steps
rank_math_title: How to File for Divorce in California (2027): $435, 6 Months
rank_math_description: California divorce 2027: 6-month + 3-month county residency, $435 fee ($870 joint), 6-month wait from service, FL-100 forms, summary dissolution.
focus_keyword: how to file for divorce in california
pdf_outline: Checklist: residency (or legal separation + amend, §2321) -> FL-100/FL-110 (+FL-105) -> file $435 / $870 joint / FW-001 -> serve (FL-115 or FL-117) -> 30-day response -> preliminary disclosure within 60 days (FL-140/142/150 + 2 yrs tax returns) -> FL-141 -> settlement -> FL-170/FL-180 -> status ends 6 months after service
